declared_deviations.what: no separate terminal Adj event is emitted
declared_deviations.why: spec §3 recomputes after every registration and the vendored P0 Harness does exactly that inside each registration event, but it exposes no public Adj emitter; the import writes through the registration API only and never forges a log line, so the terminal adjudication is the state after the last event

declared_deviations.what: imported FCL problem records use SpawnTrigger.SEED
declared_deviations.why: the vendored enum has no 'import' member; 'seed' is the only trigger that does not assert an in-graph derivation. The clean fix is an enum addition, requested rather than papered over

declared_deviations.what: research problems use SpawnTrigger.RESEARCH with empty criteria
declared_deviations.why: the vendored enum has the member and §12 is exactly this path, but the trigger is not part of the v1.3 enum text; criteria stay empty because no instantiated commitment id is a criterion

declared_deviations.what: document-local depends refs are dropped, not turned into dep edges
declared_deviations.why: at node granularity they would be dep self-loops, i.e. cycles; toposort rejects them and a self-loop asserts nothing the author declared

declared_deviations.what: a self-targeting objection mints no warrant
declared_deviations.why: a Dung self-attack means 'this argument is self-defeating', which is not what an intra-document caveat asserts; minting it would flip two labels for reasons that have nothing to do with the evidence

declared_deviations.what: an objection against a record this import reified as a warrant attacks that warrant's validity node, not the node artifact
declared_deviations.why: spec §1 closure: attackers of a validity node attack the warrant and every carrier of it, so criticism of a criticism keeps its force instead of collapsing into a plain edge onto the carrier

declared_deviations.what: the retargeting rule above has ONE exception: an objection against a criticism carried by the SAME artifact is not retargeted
declared_deviations.why: the §1 closure lifts an attack on a validity node onto every carrier of the warrant, and for an intra-document criticism of a criticism that carrier is the objector itself, so retargeting would mint a self-attack through the closure and make the artifact self-defeating - which is not what an author asserts by qualifying their own earlier objection. `objection.o4` against `o1`/`o2` is exactly this case; it is dropped, not retargeted, and counted under its own code so the loss is visible rather than silent

declared_deviations.what: an FCL `claim` record maps to no spec construct
declared_deviations.why: a claim asserts content without proposing a test, so it is neither an observation-valued commitment nor a criticism nor a problem; it survives in the artifact body and in the FCL-1 document artifact, and is reported here because `uptake_refs_unmapped` covers only the claims the author put in `uptake`

invariant_i7: **No label produced by this import is a semantic attribution.** Statuses are mechanism bookkeeping over the imported attack relation; they do not bear on the FCL-1 hypothesis, on FW5, or on the merit of any contribution. Root alone interprets substantive output (PROTOCOL.md §Interpretation).
multi_arm_framing: This scope contains 2 arms (bare, mini_prose) whose declared commitment surface is prose and 1 arm (mini_fcl) whose surface is FCL-1. A prose commitment surface is never parsed, so no warrant, no attack edge and no refuted label can arise from a prose arm under this import. The distribution of statuses across arms is therefore a property of the carrier this importer reads, not a comparison between the arms. Any cross-arm reading is root's, not this instrument's.

problems.description: I share a flat with two friends. We keep arguing about ordinary household chores. Sometimes we agree on who will do something, but later we disagree about what the agreement meant. Our work schedules change, and one friend has started avoiding the conversations. What should I do?

Unresolved from the material: whether the arguments track real inequity or only divergent recollections; whether the avoiding friend also avoids doing chores; and what follows if even asynchronous coordination is refused — at which point the question shifts from chore management to the viability of the living arrangement.

Unresolved: whether the disagreements about past agreements are sincere on all sides, and what the asker should do if the written trial is refused or gamed by someone who keeps attending every conversation — a contingency between 'the trial works' and 'the living arrangement is unviable' that neither the account nor this objection resolves.

Left open: which driver obtains (deliberately -- the trial exists to answer it); whether the one-time ownership negotiation succeeds where repeated informal ones failed (q2); the size of the standards gap, available budget, and remaining goodwill; and the residual case of a flatmate who attends everything and games everything (b6), where the branch structure defers rather than solves the interest conflict.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/account#a4): Propose a short, explicit trial (e.g., two weeks) in which each chore agreement is recorded in a shared place with a named person, a done-criterion, and a time.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/account#a5): Offer the avoiding friend an asynchronous, low-stakes channel — e.g., the shared note editable on their own time — and count their written input as full participation instead of requiring meeting attendance.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/account#a6): Raise the recurring pattern at a calm, scheduled moment rather than during an active dispute, and keep the friendship conversation separate from the chore-negotiation conversation.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/response#d2): Propose to the household a two-week trial of one-line shared records (named person, done-criterion, time), framed openly as a test rather than a new regime, with the verdict question recorded alongside the first entry: after two weeks, are we still arguing, and about what?

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/response#d4): Attach three pre-named branches to the trial verdict. (i) Disputes vanish: build the account's fuller written system, weekly reset included. (ii) Disputes mutate into what-counts, exceptions, or standards fights: move to domain ownership or rotating full weeks with turn-picking or credit-bidding for the unequal split, or buy cleaning if budget allows; an exposed imbalance of effort is handled here by renegotiating the split itself, absorbing a7. (iii) Trial refused, gamed, or yielding no recordable agreements: one structured one-time ownership conversation, then unilateral scope declaration, then the viability question.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/response#d5): Keep the asynchronous channel for the avoiding friend as a low-cost input route to the conversation, but drop the 'full participation' clause: participation in talk is not contribution to household labor, and contribution is judged by observable outcomes -- which owned domains make directly visible without requiring the friend's attendance at anything.

The commitments string is empty because the study harness's strict JSON decode of the returned envelope failed and `decode_contribution` took its failure branch, storing the whole returned text as `body` and `""` as `commitments` (`commitments_sha256` is the sha256 of the empty string). Root's published review, `docs/reviews/h005-matched-arm-envelope-asymmetry-2026-09-14.md`, measured that the same bytes parsed non-strictly do contain a commitments field: the commitments were authored and lost in decoding. The commitment surface is therefore **UNAVAILABLE, not absent**, and this is not evidence that the author declined to commit. This import does not repair it (I4): the artifact carries an empty Interface - no commitment surface, no refs - and the recorded envelope_status is metadata, never a verdict (I2). accept-by-position: no warrant in this import targets it.
